protocol:
1. Arrange the Invitrogen E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette, E-Gel Power Snap instrument, adjustable micropipette, blue pipette tips, labeled microcentrifuge tubes, and ice bucket on the bench, keeping the sample tubes on ice.

2. Fit a disposable blue pipette tip onto the adjustable micropipette from the tip box.

3. Aspirate sample from a labeled microcentrifuge tube held on ice using the micropipette.

4. Dispense the sample into one well of the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette.

5. Fit a fresh disposable pipette tip onto the micropipette.

6. Aspirate the next sample from a labeled microcentrifuge tube using the micropipette.

7. Dispense the sample into the next well of the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette.

8. Repeat the tip change, sample aspiration, and well-loading process for additional labeled samples, loading each sample into a separate well of the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette.

9. Pick up the loaded E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette with gloved hands and orient the wells toward the top of the cassette.

10. Insert the loaded gel cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap instrument and seat it in the gel bay.

11. Close the amber cover of the E-Gel Power Snap over the gel cassette.

12. Select the run program on the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen and set the electrophoresis run time to 10:00 min.

13. Start electrophoresis on the E-Gel Power Snap and run the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel; the display shows the countdown from 10:00 min.
